text:
Lin (Content): Hey team — thinking we run a small seed sprint to onboard dev ambassadors with short tutorials + one reference app + a lightweight benchmark post. Goal: content for community + assets to point into a gated webinar. timeline: 3 weeks. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Ravi (DevRel): love it. can help own 3 tutorials (quick-start, embeddings, cost-tuning). plan to make each ~10-12 min video + step-by-step markdown.
Maeve (Marketing): great. We'll need tight messaging and lead routing. Suggest: 1) hero post announcing ambassador program 2) tutorial drip 3) webinar (15 min + q&a). Want UTM scheme and signup gating.
Jonas (Growth): I can wire up inbound routing. Proposal: Typeform -> Zapier -> HubSpot. We'll attach UTMs: utm_source=dev-ambassador&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=amb_seed_sprint. I'll share a mapping sheet.
Aisha (Design): I can churn 3 hero banners + one refapp walkthrough thumbnail. Need final copy by EOD Thursday.
Lin (Content): To be concrete, deliverables: 3 tutorials (md + demo repo), 1 reference app repo (starter kit), 1 micro-benchmark blog (latency/cost narrative), 1 webinar landing page + signup flow. Owner per item?
Ravi (DevRel): I'll own tutorials + reference app code. Can split tutorials into: quickstart (text gen), embeddings quickstart, and cost/perf tuning guide. ETA: first drafts in 9 days.
Maeve (Marketing): I'll draft hero copy and email drip. Need routing details from @Jonas to set campaign. Also let's agree on target personas: PLG startup engineers + infra/platform leads.
Jonas (Growth): noted. Quick check — do we want a gated webinar (collect email only) or gated demo (collect team/company)? I recommend email only for low friction, but include optional company field. Also recommend segmenting using a hidden field `ambassador_referral=true`.
Lin (Content): low friction works. We'll gate webinar signups with email + optional company. For reference app, include a CTA: "Build with Redwood — start free" + link.
Jonas (Growth): sample webhook curl for Zapier testing (I'll run this in staging):
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/12345/abcd -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"test@example.com","utm":"utm_campaign=amb_seed_sprint"}'
```
ZapierBot: Zap created: Typeform -> Catch Hook (ID 12345) -> HubSpot Create/Update Contact. Status: staging.
Aisha (Design): quick q — what tone for hero? playful or pragmatic?
Maeve (Marketing): pragmatic with a small playful hook (one-liner). Example: "Ship LLM features with predictable cost + latency — join our Dev Ambassadors."
Ravi (DevRel): For tutorial repos I'll add a CONTRIBUTING.md so ambassadors can submit patches. Also will include a tiny benchmark script so people can reproduce perf numbers.
Lin (Content): nice. For the micro-benchmark post, we should highlight: observed median latency, tokens/sec, cost/token with batching, and one concrete config that hits sweet spot. Keep it short (600-800 words) with charts.
Jonas (Growth): I'll provide UTM macros and final Zap mapping by Monday AM. Maeve — once I hand off, can you wire email automation?
Maeve (Marketing): Yep. I'll set up the campaign and a short 3-email drip (announces tutorials, invites to webinar, follow-up with refapp).
Lin (Content): OK team — owners: Tutorials+refapp: @Ravi, Hero + drip + webinar page: @Maeve, Routing + UTMs: @Jonas, Graphics: @Aisha, Benchmark draft: @Lin. Check-in in 3 days. :rocket:
Ravi (DevRel): noted. starting PR template now.
Aisha (Design): I'll drop first banner options in #marketing-assets later today.
Jonas (Growth): routing sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/xyz (staging).
Lin (Content): thanks — small ask: can everyone add ETA to the sheet so we can surface blockers?
Maeve (Marketing): will do. Also creating mini brief for ambassadors (one-pager) — will ping for reviews. :memo:
ZapierBot: Webhook test received from 1735678915, forwarded to HubSpot staging.
Ravi (DevRel): quick note — let's include a tiny CLI snippet in tutorials to spin up the starter app: `npx redwood-infer init --example dev-ambassador`. keeps friction low.
Lin (Content): perfect. I'll compile the sprint checklist and post it here tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone! :tada:
